title: John Zonaras, Epitome historiarum, Books I–VI; «Хроника» Иоанна Зонары, кн. I–VI
author: John Zonaras
genre: Byzantine historical epitome (Jewish, Near Eastern, Persian and Macedonian history)
edition: Dindorf, Teubner 1868 (public domain). Pinder, CSHB 1841 (public domain)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia lists only a canon-law treatise in modern Russian (Bondach 2007). The chronicle exists only in medieval Slavonic
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only Banchich & Lane 2009 (12.15–13.19). Loeb Dio covers parts of 7–9. Nothing found for 1–6
other_translations: Only Renaissance Latin, French and Italian
value: A learned paraphrase of Josephus, Herodotus, Xenophon, Plutarch and Arrian, valuable for source criticism and the Byzantine reception of Persian and Alexander history. Books 7–9 are covered in the Dio candidate.
ai_feasibility: High: Atticizing but regular Greek. Source parallels allow automated alignment checks
pilot_unit: The Persian–Alexander section (Book IV), est. 6–8k words; book division to be verified
